title: Countdown to EDC Orlando 2012
description:
This weekend we're journeying back to Tinker Field to celebrate another year of EDC Orlando!

Prepare to explore three stages of world class sound and lighting, fire-spewing interactive art, hundreds of costume-clad theatrical performers, carnival rides, and an entire audiovisual adventure through a fully immersive state-of-the-art landscape.

The scene is set, and we're waiting for the most important piece of the EDC experience: YOU! 

Orlando, are you ready?

Limited tickets still available here: http://bit.ly/SCAI5u
